name: Crnogorski Telekom Data Centar Podgorica

name: One Montenegro Data Centar
notes: Official operator page (A): carrier-neutral telehousing data center built 2015 in Podgorica, 780 sqm, built to Tier 3 standards, ISO 27001 certified 2016, N+1 redundant power/cooling, 99.99% availability, dual transformer feeders, 72h diesel generators, meet-me-rack interconnection. Exact street address not disclosed on page.

name: Telenor Data Center THQ
notes: Contractor case study (IBT) for fire/safety systems at the Telenor technical headquarters (THQ) data center in Podgorica; corroborates an operator technical-HQ facility distinct from the commercial One Data Centar. Named-site contractor evidence; operator/permit confirmation outstanding.

name: Drzavni data centar / State Data Center with DR center (4iG IDI implementation)
developer: Government of Montenegro / Ministry of Public Administration; implementation by 4iG International Digital Infrastructure (4iG IDI)
notes: State DC + State Disaster Recovery centre: feasibility study presented 2025-03-11 by Ministry of Public Administration (with UNOPS, prepared by KPMG; Tier3+ standard requirement per earlier gov.me material). 2026-03-25 the Government selected 4iG Group/4iG IDI to design and operate the TIER III-certified state data centre (preparatory phase; budget TBD); law-enforcement IT programme budget EUR 54.25m is a separate line. Site/municipality not disclosed - Podgorica placeholder per methodology. Status remains planned until location/permit/build evidence appears.
